description_text:
JOB INFORMATION
Job  Title  Name:
Senior - Saviynt Application Engineer

JOB PURPOSE

The Consulting IAM Application Engineer leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) systems, ensuring scalability, compliance, and operational excellence. This role goes beyond application onboarding to architect and enhance IGA capabilities across the enterprise, integrating with broader IT and security ecosystems. 
Key responsibilities include engineering and maintaining IGA workflows, tailoring tools to organizational needs, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and drive innovation. The role also involves mentoring team members, applying software design patterns, and ensuring alignment with key performance indicators. The engineer supports audits, evaluates new technologies, and participates in a 24x7x365 on-call rotation to ensure uninterrupted support for critical systems.

The Consulting IAM System Engineer is expected to fortify our organization and spearhead the crafting, execution, and upkeep of our identity governance and administration (IGA) systems. As a Consulting IAM Application Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in masterminding, broadening, and refining our IGA capabilities beyond application onboarding. You will unite with cross-functional teams, including IT administrators, security analysts, and business stakeholders, to guarantee the effective utilization and continuous enhancement of our IGA systems. You will act as a team lead empowering other team members, and encourage growth among team members. You will help to apply software design patterns to achieve a consistent and standards approach to implementation of new features and expanding the connection with other enterprise systems with key performance indicators in focus..

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
·          Engineer  and  sustain  our identity governance and administration (IGA) systems, including architecture, workflows, and integration with various systems. 
·          Strategize  with stakeholders to  capture  requirements and  translate  them into technical specifications and design documents for IGA system  advancements . 
·          Tailor  and  refine  IGA tools and technologies to meet the organization's specific needs,  ensuring  optimal system performance. 
·          Craft  and  preserve  IGA operational procedures, guidelines, and documentation for user onboarding, access provisioning, and access recertification. 
·          Synergize  with cross-functional teams to  diagnose  and  remedy  any issues related to the IGA systems,  securing  timely resolution and minimal disruption. 
·          Monitor  and  evaluate  IGA system performance and security logs,  proactively safeguarding  against any anomalies or security incidents. 
·          Keep abreast  of emerging IGA trends, technologies, and best practices,  proposing  recommendations for process improvements and system  enhancements . 
·          Provide  technical expertise and support to IT teams and end-users,  resolving  IGA-related issues. 
·          Cultivate  a culture of security awareness and continuous improvement,  championing  IGA best practices and knowledge sharing within the organization. 
·          Collaborate  with internal and external auditors to  support  IGA-related audits and assessments,  ensuring  compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. 
·          Evaluate  and  select  IGA tools and technologies,  recommending  based on organizational needs, scalability, and ease of use. 
·          As we support hospitals that care for patients 24x7x365,  commit  to 24x7x365 on-call support rotation with 10-minute response times. 

R EPORTING STRUCTURE
Does this position formally supervise employees?  (Y / N)
No

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification:
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or related fields
Years of Experience :
7+    years of proven hands-on experience in implementing (design, development, testing and deployment) any leading IGA products in the market.
Certification
Saviynt IGA Level 200  ( Saviynt IGA Professional certification )

Skills and Capabilities
Details
People Management
·          Good  communication and telephone skills
·          Demonstrated ability to facilitate diverse groups of people in a problem–solving environment
Technical Skills
·          Saviynt
·          IAM implementation
·          Security policy development
·          System performance monitoring
·          Audit and compliance
·          Integration with enterprise technologies
·          Technical troubleshooting
·          Knowledge of Microsoft Azure
·          Proficient in Structured Query Language (SQL) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP).
·          Working knowledge of Java, Windows PowerShell scripting, SCIM, and REST APIs.
·          General understanding of Agile development methodologies.

Other Skills
·          Demonstrated experience in report development
·          Significant experience with participating in initiatives with proven performance in meeting          productivity, financial, and  stakeholder  satisfaction goals on deadline
·          Experience conferring with technical and functional experts at all levels of the enterprise in a      problem–solving environment
·          Demonstrated ability and desire to learn lines of business and business terminology
·          Demonstrated analytical and problem–solving skills
·          Demonstrated experience with problem tracking and trending
·          Ability to work independently with minimal direct supervision
·          Ability to succinctly communicate verbally and in a variety of media
·          Strong interpersonal relationship skills and the ability to work with a team
·          Willingness to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture

JOB PURPOSE
The Director of Software Engineering will provide leadership in Software Engineering & development across multiple application and development teams. This role involves collaborating with key stakeholders to establish and uphold Software Engineering standards, managing multiple teams of engineering resources, overseeing training initiatives, and enforcing industry standards for Software development. This position will involve managing direct reports (managers and staff–level) and providing oversight to skip–level employees.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Lead, organize, manage and develop a team of managers, product analysts, technical resources and subject matter experts
Personal leadership development and succession planning
Assist in continuous improvement of staff
Management of resource allocations
Manage operations of the department
Build solid relationships with leadership, business partners, staff, vendors
Manage resources, prioritizing tasks, providing resources estimates, adjusting to change
Manage, develop, implement and assess processes that support Agile methodologies
Conduct staff meetings and 1:1 engagement with staff
Prioritization of portfolio efforts / work in progress (WIP)
Create talent roadmaps for strategic alignment of product features
Create and enable strategies for making data-driven decisions on Software Engineering and future investments
Assess situations, formalize options, and provide recommendations
Work with team to review and improve processes and recommend emerging technology solutions
Engage constructively with stakeholders and foster a collaborative work environment
Responsible for operational budget, review staff allocation, department operational expenses, vendor license / maintenance fees for monthly operating reviews and annual budget exercise
Drive roadmaps and transformational journeys forg HCA Healthcare’s strategic values
Collaborate across departments to meet project milestones, allocating and adjusting resources as necessary
Lead resources in managing multiple projects teams
Drive and participate in business case development and contract negotiations
Communicate with leadership and participate in resolving conflicts involving staff, vendors, stakeholders, and business partners
Work with team to define and promote using proven methodology adhering to architecture and security standards focusing on patient safety along with physician and clinician satisfaction
Assist with project budgets, review resource cost and expenses for project monthly operating reviews
REPORTING STRUCTURE
Does this position formally supervise employees? (Y / N)Yes
JOB SPECIFICATIONS 
Qualification:Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science or related fields
Years of Experience: 12–20 years of experience:
In Software Engineering, Program management
In stakeholder management
In software development
In software architecture
In Engineering standards, Processes and Frameworks
5+ years of experience:
In a management position

People Management Skills
Strong managerial and team building skills
Process oriented, methodological 
Strong communication skills for communicating with technology resources, product SMEs, business owners and vendor
Technical Skills
Knowledge of best practices for Software development processes and methodologies
Prior management experience required, experience with software applications and full project lifecycle required and program management
Experience in leading software development projects and teams
Functional knowledge of software architecture best practices and processes
Knowledge of modern application development frameworks (C#, .NET Core, native mobile frameworks, Azure, AWS, GCP ,Java, Python, GenAI, DevOps)
Experience with Lean Development tools and Agile methodologies a plus
Other Skills
ability to balance demands of multiple assignments and staff development and retention
Strong problem resolution skills including identification, tracking, escalation, and resolution
Experience with process definition and documentation a plus
Experience in contract negotiations a plus
Willingness to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture
Upskill the team, help in teams transformational journey

JOB PURPOSE

The Manager – Software Architect is responsible for the technical design, architecture, and quality of software solutions across one or more engineering teams. This role provides hands on technical leadership, ensuring alignment with architectural standards, security principles, and technology best practices. The Manager will guide engineers, contribute to design and code reviews, support development activities, and collaborate with cross functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and customer focused products. 

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Lead efforts to architect, design, develop, deploy, and support software systems
Architect and design robust, secure data integrations with other HCA Healthcare India or vendor systems
Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and the development team on product architecture and technical design
Provide technical leadership in large-scale development projects involving multiple areas outside of the core team
Collaborate with other technical teams across HCA Healthcare India
Design fit–for–purpose products to ensure products align with the customer's strategic plans and technology road maps
Demonstrate a deep understanding of value–based decision–making and Agile principles across teams
Coach the team on the existing system structure, constraints, and deficiencies with the product
Mentor developers in software development and architectural practices
Contribute to a smooth CI / CD pipeline
Share knowledge and experience to contribute to the growth of overall team capabilities
Provide leadership in the deployment, change, configuration, management, administration, and maintenance of the deployment process and systems
Focus on customer satisfaction
Rapidly prototypes and delivers just–in–time solutions
Work in an environment with rapidly changing business requirements and priorities
Demonstrate deep understanding and act as a leader in the team’s continuous integration and continuous delivery automation pipeline
Establish and drive adoption of best practices for architectural and coding patterns, DevOps practices, and framework usage
Collaborate with product managers and designers to ensure the feasibility of product direction
Architect and design software products and lead the development and implementation of solutions with minimal supervision
Provide on–going technical support for both existing and new applications

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Does this position formally supervise employees? (Y / N)YES

JOB SPECIFICATIONS
Qualification:
B.Tech or Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer Science, or related fields

Years of Experience: 8–14 years of experience in:
Technical leadership in small to medium multi–role teams minimum 2+ years
Development background with expertise in .NET, C#, python, as well as database design and development experience for transactional and reporting databases on relational and NoSQL platforms
 Skills and CapabilitiesDetails
People management
History of technical leadership in small to medium multi–role teams

Strong experience with Relational and Non-Relational databases.

title: Level II - Data Engineer
description_text:
Position Summary

The Data Engineer serves as a primary
development resource for writing code, test, implementation, document
functionality, and maintaining NextGen solutions for the Google Cloud
Platform (GCP) enterprise data initiatives. This role requires working
closely with data teams, frequently in a matrixed environment as part of a
broader project team. Due to the emerging and fast-evolving nature of GCP
technology and practice, the position requires that one stay well-informed
of technological advancements and be proficient at putting new innovations
into effective practice.

As a Data Engineer you will be part of the data engineering community which
includes data platforms, data warehousing, data science, software
engineering, and visual insights. We use our data infrastructure to power
analytics and data products and to deliver relevant experiences in
real-time. We enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make
smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world of healthcare.

HCA DT&I is on a mission to change the face of the healthcare industry
through value-driven technology and products. You will be part of a small
agile team with a mission of innovating data products for all users of
healthcare across HCA’s nationwide ecosystem. At the intersection of
healthcare and technology is the opportunity to change lives for the better
through technology modernization, curiosity, and adapting or setting
industry best practices.

Major Responsibilities:

·         
Work with data
engineers, data architects, data scientists, and other internal stakeholders
to understand product requirements and then design, build, and monitor data
platforms and pipelines that meet today's requirements but can gracefully
scale.

·         
Implement automated
workflows that lower manual/operational costs, define and uphold SLAs for
timely delivery of data, and move the company closer to democratizing data.

·         
Promote a
collaborative team environment that prioritizes effective communication, team
member growth, and success of the team over success of the individual.

·         
Design and create real-time
data pipelines that accelerate the time from idea to insight.

·         
Adheres to and
supports data engineering best practices, processes, and standards.

·         
Produce high
quality, modular, reusable code that incorporates best practices and serves
as an example for less experienced engineers.

·         
Supports data
security best practices that align with industry standards and regulatory and
legal requirements.

·         
Supports data
analysis efforts and solution proposals to data related and data architecture
problems.

·         
Supports
implementation of unit and integration tests and promote and conduct
performance testing where appropriate.

·         
Be a leader in the
HCA data community. Evangelize data engineering best practices and standards,
participate in community events, and encourage the continual growth and
development of others.

·         
Be curious. Be growth
minded. Encourage and enable this in others.

·         
Demonstrate
professional and personal maturity through self-leadership.

·         
Build productive and
healthy relationships within the department and other teams to foster growth
of our culture, our people, and our platforms.

·         
Practices
and adheres to the “Code of Conduct” philosophy and “Mission and Value
Statement.”

·         
Performs other
duties as assigned

A successful candidate will
have:

•                     
Good understanding of best practices and standards
for GCP Data process design and implementation.

•                     
2+ Years of hands-on experience with GCP platform
and experience with many of the following components:

o    Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud
Functions

o    Spark Streaming, Kafka,
Pub/Sub

o    Bigtable, Firestore, Cloud
SQL, Cloud Spanner

o    JSON, Avro, Parquet

o    Python, Java, Terraform

o    Big Query, Dataflow, Data
Fusion

o    Cloud Composer, DataProc,
CI/CD, Cloud Logging

o    Vertex AI, NLP, GitHub

•                     
Ability to multitask and to balance competing
priorities.

•                     
Ability to define and utilize best practice
techniques and to impose order in a fast-changing environment.

•                     
Strong problem-solving skills.

•                     
Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills,
including a desire to work within a highly matrixed, team-oriented
environment.

A successful candidate may
have:

•                     
Experience in Healthcare Domain

Hardware/Operating Systems:

•                     
GCP

•                     
Distributed, highly scalable processing
environments.

•                     
Linux, UNIX

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORKING
CONDITIONS (Specific statements of physical effort required and description

Prolonged sitting or standing at computer workstations
including use of mouse, keyboard, and monitor.

•                     
Requires ability to provide after-hours support.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field

Preferred

•

1+ year(s) of experience in data engineering, data

Licenses, Certifications, & Training:

Preferred

Preferred

·          

Demonstrates an empathetic and growth
mindset with a willingness to learn new skills, technologies, and

Growing knowledge of public cloud best
practices and design patterns used in creating, automating, and supporting
data pipelines.

sets of data that meet functional and non-functional product requirements.

title: Senior - Data Engineer
description_text:
Position Summary

The Senior Data Engineer serves as a primary development
resource for design, build, implementation, and support of DT&I Clinical
Data Engineering initiatives. This role requires working closely with data
teams, frequently in a matrixed environment as part of a broader project
team. As a senior-level position the role requires ‘self-starters’ who are
proficient in problem solving and capable of bringing clarity to complex
situations. The culture of the organization places an emphasis on teamwork,
so social and interpersonal skills are equally important as technical
capability. Due to the emerging and fast-evolving nature of Big Data/GCP
technology and practice, the position requires that one stay well-informed
of technological advancements and be proficient at putting new innovations
into effective practice.

In addition, this candidate will have a history of increasing responsibility
in a small multi-role team. This position requires a candidate who can
analyze business requirements, perform design tasks, construct, test, and
implement solutions with minimal supervision. This candidate will have a
record of accomplishment of participation in successful projects in a fast-paced,
mixed team (consultant and employee) environment. In addition, the applicant
must be willing to mentor other developers to prepare them for assuming their
responsibilities.

Major Responsibilities:

Core Competencies

The following are
highlighted entrepreneurial competencies and core expectations for the
job/role:

§  
Communication and interpersonal skills

§   Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

§  
Understand strategic imperatives.

§  
Technology & business knowledge

This role will provide
application development for specific business environments. Focus on setting
technical direction on groups of applications and similar technologies as
well as taking responsibility for technically robust solutions encompassing
all business, architecture, and technology constraints.

§   Responsible for building and supporting a GCP based ecosystem designed
for enterprise-wide analysis of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured
data.

§   Support regular requests to move data from one cluster to another.

§   Make sure service levels are maintained, and any interruption is
resolved in a timely fashion.

§   Analyze requirements, design AI/ML based solutions, and integrate
those solutions for customer environments.

§   Closely collaborates with team members to successfully execute
development initiatives using Agile practices and principles. 

§   Leads efforts to design, development, deploy, and support software systems.

§   Collaborate with business analysts, project lead, management, and
customers on requirements.

§   Participates in the deployment, change, configuration, management, administration,
and maintenance of deployment process and systems.

§   Proven experience effectively prioritizing workload to meet deadlines
and work objectives.

§   Gather requirements, designs, constructs and deliver solutions with
minimal team interaction.

Position Summary

We are
seeking an experienced and highly skilled Data Architect to join our dynamic
team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data
architecture, cloud-based data solutions, and data engineering, with
hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). In this role, you will
be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing scalable,
high-performance data solutions that support advanced analytics, AI/ML, and
real-time decision-making across our enterprise.

As a key technical leader, you will collaborate closely with data engineers,
software engineers, cloud architects, data modelers and business
stakeholders to develop a modern data ecosystem that enables seamless
integration of structured and unstructured data, ensures robust governance
and security, and drives innovation in healthcare data management. You will
leverage technologies such as BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Vertex
AI and Apache Iceberg/Delta Lake to build a unified and efficient data
platform.

Data Architects are expected to come into the position with a great deal of
prior knowledge and experience, and need to demonstrate the ability to learn
quickly and drive a team-oriented environment.  Extensive experience in data engineering
and data management is important in this position as well as exposure to
Business Intelligence/Artificial Intelligence tools and concepts, as a
strategic goal of the organization is to build an integrated and enterprise
grade Lakehouse environment.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the next-generation data strategy
for a leading healthcare organization, enabling insights that improve
patient outcomes, enhance operational efficiency, and support regulatory
compliance. If you are passionate about data architecture, cloud

Director Automation

JOB
INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Director, Automation

HCA Grade / Level :

JOB PURPOSE

The Director of Automation is
responsible for the leadership and stewardship of the Automation Center of
Excellence teams, including but not limited to Operational Support, Business
Intelligence and Automation Delivery. They are responsible for leading and
coaching the management staff with a focus on providing guidance and
expertise for leadership development, continuous improvement of uninterrupted
operations, planning / executing development efforts and implementing strategies
that ensure the Automation department can continue to deliver increasing
value over time. The Director uses their team of automation engineers to
define solutions for enterprise impacting automation ideas, develop those
solutions using the appropriate technical framework, and provide ongoing
support through the automation lifecycle. The Director uses their team of
system engineers and automation analysts to implement, support, and maintain
enterprise automation.

The Director of Automation will
lead teams who align business and operational priorities with technology
resilience, leveraging best practices, staffing partners and fulltime
offshore resources to maximize system availability and stakeholder
satisfaction. This individual will define technology roadmaps, set problem
priorities, establish standards based on best practices and provide direction
and priority to IT operational teams through the technical leaders who
maintain product backlogs. The Director needs good communication and
interpersonal skills and will be interfacing directly with executives and
product teams across the organization. The candidate should demonstrate an
understanding of complex ideas and broadly communicate a product technology
strategy and meet the needs of the team and stakeholders. This role requires
attentive listening and demonstrating a strong executive presence as they
will routinely meet with senior-level business management and present to
large groups. The Director of Automation will perform all duties with a focus
on quality of work, attention to detail and a high level of self-management
and self-awareness.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Core
responsibilities

·

·         
Direct strategic development, management, and deployment of
automation development across business lines.

·         
Ensure application design to manage and maintain data security
and integrity.

·         
Ensures the utilization of software release management.

·         
Deliver software, infrastructure and architecture that meets
the needs of automation stakeholders.

·         
Implement mechanisms to monitor, manage and provide progress
on all software development activities.

·         
Ensure the on time and quality delivery of software
development projects.

·         
Develop and maintains internal and external IT support systems.

·         
Deploy and implement new automation technologies across the
enterprise.

·         
Create, implement, and maintain a continuous improvement plan
for automation development.

·         
Drive consistent standards and
approaches throughout the development teams.

·         
Provide enterprise consultation on
automation best practices and development.

·         
Prepares specifications of a highly
technical or complex nature.

·         
Improve productivity and efficiency;
promote continuous improvement.

·         
Develop strategic relationships with
vendors, especially for sourcing onshore and offshore resources.

·         
Evaluate current and emerging tools
and technologies and recommend these tools to executive management.

·         
Be willing to lead by example and have
an unmistakably clear set of strong business and personal ethics.

·         
Create a positive environment for the
team including open, honest communication and creating a clear path to
escalate risks and issues. This individual should be a coach, who mentors,
motivates, and supervises project team members and contractors.

·         
Serve as primary point of contact for automation technology
and platforms.

·         
Support of the enterprise development community through
engagement, development support, and platform availability.

·         
Manage costs and expenditures against department budget to
include labor, contracts, vendors, and software.

years of relevant experience

title: Manager - Product Development
description_text:
JOB INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Manager – Product Development

JOB
PURPOSE

 

The individual provides
technical leadership and expertise for developing and supporting new and
existing software products at HCA Healthcare. He/She will lead the design and
delivery of scalable, secure, and cost-efficient solutions that align with
business goals. This role involves managing a team of engineers, ensuring
adherence to industry standards, and driving innovation in cloud
infrastructure and application development. The role requires effective
collaboration with our HQ teams in the US and with cross-functional teams to
implement robust cloud strategies and applications while optimizing
performance and costs. This individual will analyze business requirements,
perform design tasks, construct, test, and implement solutions with little supervision
in an agile development environment, and mentor other developers.

 

MAJOR
RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Development and Project Management

Ensure Development Standards:
Maintain code and version control using HCA Healthcare standards.

Lead Development Projects: Oversee
projects from inception to implementation.

Unit Testing and Code Reviews: Ensure
thorough testing and peer reviews.

Advanced Troubleshooting: Provide
advanced user support and troubleshooting.

Technology Adoption and
Innovation

Establish KPIs: Set and evaluate key
performance indicators for technology adoption.

Process Improvement: Implement
changes to enhance technology adoption.

Training: Conduct and ensure relevant
training for technology adoption.

Technology Acquisition: Identify and
manage the acquisition of new technologies .

Emerging Technologies

Research and Evaluation: Stay updated
on emerging technologies and evaluate their potential for
organizational use.

Innovation Implementation: Lead the
implementation of innovative technologies to enhance business
processes.

Pilot Programs: Develop and manage
pilot programs for new technologies.

Technology Roadmap: Create and
maintain a roadmap for emerging technology integration .

Software Development Lifecycle

Lead SDLC: Manage the software
development lifecycle for key projects.

Technical Product Management: Serve
as the Technical Product Manager, gathering requirements and managing
stories.

Agile Principles: Promote and
implement Agile development principles.

Team and Process Management

Manage Development Team: Oversee
developers, business analysts, quality assurance, and support staff.

Application Support: Ensure timely
and effective application support.

Cross-departmental assistance:
Provide support and advice to other teams as needed.

Collaboration and Evaluation

Technology Evaluation: Collaborate
with architects to evaluate new technologies.

Collaboration: Work with leadership
and clients to deliver application enhancements.

Revenue-Generating Solutions:
Identify and evaluate potential revenue-generating solutions.

Architecture Strategy and
Implementation

Cloud Architecture Strategy: Develop
and execute cloud architecture strategies.

Cloud Solutions Design: Design and
implement secure cloud solutions.

Migration Oversight: Oversee cloud
migration efforts.

Standards and Compliance

Architecture Standards: Establish and
enforce architecture standards and security measures.

Regulatory Compliance: Ensure
compliance with industry regulations .

Cost and Performance
Optimization

Resource Optimization: Monitor and
optimize cloud resource usage.

Performance Improvements: Identify
opportunities for performance improvements and cost control.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification

·       
B.Tech or Bachelor’s degree in information
technology, computer science or related fields

·        Relevant certifications such
as Google Professional Cloud Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert
are a plus.

Years
of Experience

·       
Total 10+ years’ experience in engineering

·        Minimum of 5 years in cloud
architecture or related fields.

·       
At least 3-5 years of experience in leading and
managing cloud teams.

Skills
and Capabilities

Details

People Management

·       
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop
high-performing teams.

·       
Experience conducting performance reviews, setting
goals, and creating career development plans for team members.

·       
Strong interpersonal skills to foster collaboration
across diverse teams.

Technical Skills

·        Expertise in cloud platforms like GCP and Azure .

·        Expertise
with container orchestration tools such
as Kubernetes, GKE, and Cloud Run.

·        Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Node.js, and
polyglot programming practices.

·       
Experience with data
orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Composer) and real-time streaming
solutions like GCP Pub/Sub and Kafka.

·       
Experience with even Driven
Architecture.

·       
Experience
with Redis Cache/ Centralized Caching implementations

·       
Hands-on experience with
Terraform, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines.

·        Strong knowledge of databases, including PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and other
NoSQL solutions.

·       
Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools
like Prometheus, Grafana, Stackdriver, and Azure Monitor.

·       
Experience with Dynatrace will
be a plus.

·       
Deep understanding of cloud security best practices and
compliance requirements.

·       
Understanding of CI/CD and Terraform

Other Skills

·        Exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate technical
strategies to non-technical stakeholders.

·        Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.

·        Experience in managing budgets, optimizing cloud costs, and driving ROI.

·       
A proactive
mindset with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.

description_text:
JOB INFORMATION
Job  Title  Name:
Manager  - Product Development

JOB PURPOSE

The Manager of Product Development is responsible for providing technical leadership and expertise for developing and supporting new and existing software products within Custom Application Research & Development (CARD) at HCA Healthcare. This individual will analyze business requirements, perform design tasks, construct, test, and  cloud-native  implement solutions in an agile development environment, and provide mentorship to other developers.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
·         Development Standards:  Ensure that staff engineers adhere to HCA Healthcare's established standards and procedures for development activities. This includes maintaining code and version control through the specified application development software.
·         Project Management:  Lead and manage development projects from inception through to implementation. This involves overseeing the entire project lifecycle, including planning, elaboration, development, testing, and deployment.
·         Testing and Reviews:  Ensure that employees complete unit testing for their code and participate in peer/code reviews of other developers' work to maintain high-quality standards.
·         User Support:  Provide advanced troubleshooting and user support, working directly with end users at all levels of the organization to resolve issues and improve user experience.
·         Performance Metrics:  Establish baseline key performance indicators (KPIs) and gather relevant operating metrics to evaluate the impact of new technology adoption before and after implementation.
·         Process Improvement:  Identify and implement process changes that enhance technology adoption. This includes adding, changing, or removing processes as necessary.
·         Training:  Conduct training sessions and ensure that relevant training is provided to help employees adopt new technologies effectively.
·         Software Development Lifecycle:  Lead the software development lifecycle process for projects aimed at stabilizing, enhancing, and expanding the capabilities CARD team.
·         Requirement Gathering:  Gather requirements from the product owner and other business stakeholders. This includes authoring stories with strong acceptance criteria, prioritizing stories, accepting or rejecting stories, coordinating with other technical teams, and removing team roadblocks.
·         Staff Management:  Manage all staff members involved in the software development process, including developers, business analysts, quality assurance, and support personnel.
·         Application Support:  Manage ongoing application support by ensuring that support tickets are assigned to team members appropriately and completed in a manner that meets or exceeds predefined service level agreements (SLAs).
·         Agile Principles : Evangelize and implement Agile development principles across the entire CARD department and other HCA Healthcare stakeholders to improve development processes and outcomes.
·         Technology Evaluation:  In cooperation with HCA Healthcare architects, evaluate all proposed innovative technologies for departmental use and organizational fit.
·         Collaboration:  Collaborate with corporate and divisional leadership, client executives, clients, and project managers to schedule, staff, and deliver application enhancements.

R EPORTING STRUCTURE
Does this position formally supervise employees?  (Y / N)
Yes

JOB SPECIFICATIONS
Qualification
B.Tech or Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science or related fields
Years of Experience
Overall, 10–15 years of experience.
·         5-7 years of experience in  Managing product development lifecycles, user testing, interaction design, and  Agile development.
·         3+ years of team management experience.

Skills and Capabilities
Details
People Management
·         Management of staff, lead and implemented projects
·         S taff meetings, resource allocation management, performance reviews, time management, PTO, employee development planning, and mentoring

Technical Skills
·         Hands-on experience building cloud native .NET applications (GCP is preferred)
·         Strong knowledge in leading front-end, back-end, database developers
·         Familiarity with Lean / Agile techniques in development environment
·         Knowledge of version control tools like GitHub, Azure Repos
·         Knowledfe of Project & Service management toold like Jira,  Azure DevOps and  MS  P rojects
·         Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
·         Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
·         Experience in the healthcare industry is a plus.
Other Skills
·         Highly motivated, self–starter and committed to delivering high-quality solutions within agreed–upon timelines
·         Communicate clearly, professionally, and regularly with team and CARD colleagues
·         Willingness to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture

description_text:
Director - Product
Development

JOB
INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Director - Product Development

HCA Grade / Level:

Director

JOB PURPOSE

T he Director of Product Development will provide
leadership in p roduct management
& development across multiple application and development teams. This role involves
collaborating with key stakeholders to establish and uphold product
management standards, managing multiple teams of product analysts, engineering
resources, overseeing
training initiatives, and enforcing industry standards for product
development. This position will involve managing direct reports (managers and
staff–level) and providing oversight to skip–level employees.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

·         
Lead, organize, manage and develop a team of managers, product
analysts, technical resources and subject matter experts

·         
Personal leadership development and succession planning

·         
Assist in continuous improvement of staff

·         
Management of resource allocations

·         
Manage operations of the department

·         
Build solid relationships with leadership, business partners,
staff, vendors

·         
Manage resources, prioritizing tasks, providing resources
estimates, adjusting to change

·         
Manage, develop, implement and assess processes that support
Agile methodologies

·         
Conduct staff meetings and 1:1 engagement with staff

·         
Prioritization of portfolio efforts / work in progress (WIP)

·         
Create roadmaps for strategic alignment of product features

·         
Create and enable strategies for making data-driven decisions
on product features and future investments

·         
Assess situations, formalize options, and provide
recommendations

·         
Work with team to review and improve processes and recommend
emerging technology solutions

·         
Engage constructively with stakeholders and foster a
collaborative work environment

·         
Responsible for operational budget, review staff allocation,
department operational expenses, vendor license / maintenance fees for monthly
operating reviews and annual budget exercise

·         
Drive product roadmaps and features driving HCA Healthcare’s
strategic values

·         
Collaborate across departments to meet project milestones,
allocating and adjusting resources as necessary

·         
Lead resources in managing multiple projects

·         
Drive and participate in business case development and contract
negotiations

·         
Communicate with leadership and participate in resolving
conflicts involving staff, vendors, stakeholders, and business partners

·         
Work with team to define and promote using proven methodology
adhering to architecture and security standards focusing on patient safety
along with physician and clinician satisfaction

·         
Assist with project budgets, review resource cost and expenses
for project monthly operating reviews

R EPORTING STRUCTURE

Does this
position formally supervise employees? (Y / N)

Yes

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification :

Bachelor’s
degree in information technology, computer science or related fields

Years of Experience :

12–15 years of experience:

·         
In product development and product
management

·         
In stakeholder management

·         
In software development

·         
In software architecture

In development frameworks

5+ years of experience:

·         
In a management position

Skills
and Capabilities

Details

People
Management Skills

·         
Strong
managerial and team building skills

·         
Strong
communication skills for communicating with technology resources, product
SMEs, business owners and vendor

Technical
Skills

·         
Knowledge
of best practices for product development processes and methodologies

·         
Prior
management experience required, experience with software applications and
full project lifecycle required

·         
Experience
in leading software development projects or teams

·         
Functional
knowledge of software architecture best practices and processes

·         
Knowledge
of modern application development frameworks (C#, .NET Core, native mobile
frameworks, Azure, AWS, GCP)

·         
Experience
with Lean Development tools and Agile methodologies a plus

Other
Skills

·         
Ability
to balance demands of multiple assignments and staff development and
retention

·         
Strong problem
resolution skills including identification, tracking, escalation, and
resolution

·         
Experience
with process definition and documentation a plus

·         
Experience
in contract negotiations a plus

·         
Willingness
to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture

title: Consultant - Android Developer
description_text:
Consultant Mobile Developer

Android

JOB INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Consultant Mobile Developer

HCA India Grade / Level:

Senior

JOB
PURPOSE

We are seeking a Consultant Mobile Developer with deep expertise in
building enterprise-scale Android applications. The ideal candidate has
hands-on experience across multiple mobile programming languages, modern UI
design, cloud-native development, and enterprise-grade security. You will
lead the end-to-end delivery of robust, scalable, and secure mobile
solutions, integrating with IoT and medical devices, and collaborating
cross-functionally to drive product excellence.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

·        Lead
design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise-grade Android
applications with high performance, reliability, and security.

·        Architect
modular, maintainable codebases using industry-standard patterns (e.g.,
MVVM, Clean Architecture, Repository, DI).

·        Design
intuitive, accessible, and consistent UI/UX following Material Design
guidelines and design systems.

·        Implement
and optimize session management, caching strategies, and efficient memory
utilization on-device and in the cloud.

·        Integrate
mobile apps with IoT and medical devices via Bluetooth (BLE) and Wi-Fi,
ensuring secure pairing, data transfer, and compliance.

·        Develop
and maintain secure data flows, offline-first capabilities, and resilient
synchronization with cloud services and APIs.

·        Own
deployment strategies (staged rollouts, feature flags, remote config, A/B
testing) and app distribution via Google Play and enterprise channels
(MDM/EMM).

·        Ensure
cloud-native integration (e.g., REST/GraphQL APIs, Pub/Sub, event streams)
with robust observability (logging, metrics, tracing).

·        Champion
enterprise security best practices (encryption, key management, secure
storage, certificate pinning, secure BLE/Wi-Fi, OAuth2/OpenID Connect).

·        Drive
performance tuning (startup time, rendering, battery, network efficiency)
and memory profiling (LeakCanary/Android Studio Profiler).

·        Establish
and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines, code quality gates, and testing
strategies (unit, integration, UI/E2E).

·        Collaborate
with Product, Design, QA, Security, and Cloud teams; mentor engineers;
conduct code reviews; set technical standards.

·        Author
and maintain technical documentation, SDKs, and reusable components.

·        Communicate complex technical
topics clearly to stakeholders; lead technical discussions and
decision-making.

R EPORTING STRUCTURE

Does this
position formally supervise employees? (Y / N)

No

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification :

B. Tech or Bachelor’s degree in information
technology, computer science, or related fields

Years
of Experience :

·        8– 15 years of
professional experience developing Android applications at enterprise
scale.

·       
Strong object–oriented Java
experience, preferably with large–scale systems

·       
Hands on experience with Android
application development

·        Experience
in published examples of mobile applications on the App Store or the
Android Market

·        Experience
with or familiarity with iOS SDK

Skills
and Capabilities

Details

People Management

·        Strong verbal and written communication with the ability to work with
staff and business

require d

Technical Skills

·        Expert in Kotlin and Java; proficiency with additional mobile
languages/frameworks (e.g., Swift, Flutter/Dart, React Native/TypeScript) is
a strong plus.

·        Deep knowledge of Android frameworks: Jetpack Compose and/or XML Views,
Jetpack components (LiveData/Flow/Coroutines, Navigation, Room/DataStore,
WorkManager).

·        Strong experience with design and architecture patterns: MVVM, Clean
Architecture, SOLID, Dependency Injection (Hilt/Dagger/Koin).

·        Hands-on experience integrating IoT and medical devices via Bluetooth/BLE
and Wi-Fi, including GATT profiles, permissions, pairing flows, and secure
communication.

·        Proven enterprise security expertise: data encryption (AES/GCM), secure
storage (Keystore/Hardware-backed keys), TLS/SSL, certificate pinning,
OAuth2/OIDC, secure BLE/Wi-Fi.

·        Cloud-native development experience with one or more platforms (AWS, GCP,
Azure): API gateways, serverless functions, messaging/streaming, secrets
management, monitoring.

·        Strong session management strategies, caching (in-memory, disk,
database), and memory optimization on device and cloud interactions.

·        Experience with modern development practices: CI/CD (GitHub
Actions/Bitrise/Jenkins), automated testing, code quality tools (Detekt,
Lint, Ktlint), feature flags, remote config.

·        Proficient in performance profiling and optimization (Android Studio
Profiler, Systrace), network efficiency (HTTP/2/3, gRPC), and offline-first
data sync.

·        Excellent communication skills; able to explain complex topics to
technical and non-technical audiences.

·        Experience building SDKs/libraries, modular multi-module projects, and
internal design systems.

·        Familiarity with edge processing, background services, and power/battery
optimization.

·        Experience with observability tools (Firebase Crashlytics/Performance,
Sentry, Datadog, New Relic).

·        Experience with enterprise mobility management (EMM/MDM), private app
stores, and managed deployments.

Other Skills

·        Experince on both small and large teams

·        Strong focus on delivering customer value required

·        Excellent troubleshooting, analysis, and problem-solving abilities
required

·        Team mindset with willingness to work with and mentor other mobile devs

·        Willingness to learn our business domain required

·        Highly motivated self–starter,
an enthusiastic learner willing to learn new frameworks and

methodologies and must be committed to delivering high quality solutions
within scheduled

timelines

·       
Willingness to contribute to a positive and
inclusive team culture

title: Consultant - Software Engineer
description_text:
JOB INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Consultant - Software Engineer

JOB
PURPOSE

As a Consultant- Software Engineer, your primary
role is to develop, maintain, and optimize server-side applications. You will
ensure these applications meet high-performance, scalability, and reliability
standards. The role involves working with modern technologies, managing data
flow, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative
solutions. A strong background in both front-end and back-end development,
coupled with experience in cloud-based technologies, is essential.

MAJOR
RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Core
Development:

·         
Experience in Visual Studio,
C#, SQL programming, SSIS, JSON, LINQ, jQuery, Entity Framework, ORM,  Microservices, REST and Web API.

·         
Can work with message
queues/eventing (Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ) and understands eventual
consistency.

·         
Write clean, efficient, and
well-documented code adhering to coding standards and testing best
practices.

·         
Develop scalable and secure
back-end components of web applications, ensuring performance and
reliability.

·         
Design and implement RESTful
APIs to support front-end functionality.

Cloud Computing & Infrastructure:

·         
Deploy and manage applications
on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

·         
Leverage cloud-native services
for development, data integration, and continuous deployment.

·         
Optimize cloud resources for
performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.

·         
Automate provisioning and
resource management using tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and
Argo CD .

Data Management:

·         
Design and maintain databases
using PostgreSQL, SQL, and BigQuery.

·         
Optimize data pipelines and
workflows using Google Dataflow, Google Composer (or Apache Airflow)
for task orchestration and scheduling.

·         
Work with structured and
unstructured datasets for data flow and analytics.

·         
Utilize Kafka for building
real-time data pipelines and streaming applications.

·         
Write and optimize complex SQL
queries for data analysis and transformations.

DevOps & CI/CD:

·         
Implement and manage CI/CD
pipelines (GIT Hub) for seamless code deployment.

·         
Enhance system observability
through logging, monitoring, and alerting strategies .

Security & Compliance:

·         
Ensure applications meet
security standards and best practices.

·         
Collaborate with security
teams to address vulnerabilities and enforce compliance requirements.

·         
Adhere to data protection
protocols like HIPAA.

R EPORTING STRUCTURE

Does this position formally supervise employees? (Y / N)

No

JOB
SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification

Bachelor’s
degree in information technology, computer science or related fields

Y ears of E xperience

8-10 Years of relevant work
experience including :

·         
4+ year(s) of experience in designing applications using SOLID clean architecture (required)

·         
4+
year(s) in APIs/contracts ,
versioning strategy, microservices
& integration patterns (required)

Skills
and Capabilities

Details

People Management Skills

·         
Exceptional stakeholder service
skills in a team–oriented, collaborative environment

·         
Exceptional interpersonal
skills to interface with all levels of the organization

·         
Strong
verbal and written communication with the ability to work with staff and
business           required

Technical
Skills

Programming & Frameworks:  Experience in Visual Studio, C#, SQL
programming, SSIS, JSON, LINQ, jQuery, ORM, Rabbit MQ, Microservices, REST
and Web API.

·         
Cloud Platforms: Experience with GCP and their services like
Kubernetes, Cloud Functions, Composer, BigQuery, and DataFlow.

·         
Infrastructure: Experience with tools like Terraform, ARM
templates, and Docker.

·         
Databases: Expertise in PostgreSQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, and
non-relational databases.

·         
Workflow & Messaging Tools: Hands-on experience with Google
Composer (or Apache Airflow) for workflow orchestration and Kafka for
real-time data streaming.

·         
Automation Tools: Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins,
Argo CD, and similar tools.

·         
API Development: Skilled in RESTful API design and development.

·         
Programming Languages: Proficient in JavaScript, Python, and SQL

Other
Skills

·         
Strong focus on security best
practices and cloud-native development.

·         
Knowledge of healthcare data
standards is a plus.

·         
Willingness to contribute to a
positive and inclusive team culture.

description_text:
Position Summary
The Consulting Product Analyst drives innovation in healthcare technology by analyzing business systems, eliciting
requirements, and guiding the development of effective solutions.

Major Responsibilities:

· Support strategic and operational initiatives for HCA’s Costing, Analytics, and Pricing Services.
· Collaborate with stakeholders, business users, and technical teams to ensure solutions meet business needs.
· Lead and support complex projects, often guiding other analysts
· Translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications
· Understand and interpret business area supported to assist in developing product roadmap and strategy
· Facilitate and document requirement gathering meetings with business users
· Prioritize requirements and create conceptual prototypes and mock-ups
· Provide expertise in process design and provide leadership in communicating requirements to product development, testing, and education/training
· Collaborate with developers and QA teams to ensure solutions meet business needs
· Participate in the sprint management process, and execute on assigned responsibilities
· Participate in user acceptance testing and testing of new system functionality
· Support application training documentation creation
· Direct quality measures for department deliverables
· Build strong relationships within the department and company, including business owners
· Participate in the day-to-day support and operational activities
· Thoroughly understand assigned Business applications and user impact
· Drive continuous improvement in analysis tools and templates

· Performs other duties as assigned
· Practices and adheres to the “Code of Conduct” philosophy and “Mission and Value Statement.”

Education & Experience:
• Bachelor's degree Business Administration Preferred
• Bachelor's degree Other Preferred
• 7 years of relevant work experience Required

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors:
· Service and Quality Excellence: Ability to demonstrate an uncompromising commitment to delivering exceptional care to create an unmatched value proposition for our patients. Required
· Honor our Mission and Values: Ability to build trust and act with authenticity to cultivate a culture of integrity, inclusion, and mutual respect Required
· Effective Decision Making: Ability to make timely, informed decisions that are in the best interest of our patients, employees, providers, community and HCA. Required
· Attain and Leverage Strategic Relationships: Ability to develop and strengthen collaborative relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to advance the care of our patients and the growth of HCA. Required
· Lead and Develop Others: Ability to lead others to accomplish organizational goals and objectives; provide meaningful coaching and mentoring to increase the capabilities of individuals and teams and drive employee engagement. Required
· Communicate with Impact: Ability to deliver information in a clear, concise, and compelling manner to effectively engage others and achieve desired results. Required
· Achieve Success through Change: Ability to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation, remove barriers and resistance, and enable desired behaviors. Required
· Drive Execution and Financial Results: Ability to commit to the success and financial wellbeing of HCA by challenging others to excel and hold themselves and others accountable for achieving results

description_text:
JOB INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Senior -  SDET

JOB
PURPOSE

The Sr. QA Automation Engineer (Sr. SDET) manages and
performs all aspects of the application and functional testing activities for
a healthcare project. The position requires deep technical skills, the
ability to grasp business concepts quickly and experience working in an agile
environment. The ideal candidate will consistently strive to learn emerging
technologies that would be useful for the job role.  Further, this position will require
outstanding communication skills in order to collaborate with the project
team.

for UI testing (using Selenium) and API Testing (using Postman/Newman)

WebDrivers for UI automation.

efficient test scripts in programming languages like Python or JavaScripts.

teams to understand business requirements and translate them into test

functional, integration, regression and performance test cases.

CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, or Azure DevOps

testing tools like JMeter.

Cucumber or SpecFlow.

certification

·        Helps define and implement operational and process
improvements for testing activities; enables increase in quality of

delays

framework for use of DB, API, UI, mobile and performance testing

description_text:
JOB INFORMATION
Job  Title  Name:
Level II – SDET

JOB PURPOSE
The  Level II  QA Automation Engineer  or SDET  manages and performs all aspects of the application and functional testing activities for a healthcare project. The position requires deep technical skills, the ability to grasp business concepts quickly and experience working in an agile environment. The ideal candidate will consistently strive to learn emerging technologies that would be useful for the job role.  Further, this position will require outstanding communication skills in order to collaborate with the project team.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
·           Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for UI testing (using Selenium) and API Testing (using Postman/Newman)
·           Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDrivers for UI automation.
·           Write reusable, maintainable and efficient test scripts in programming languages like Python or JavaScripts.
·           Collaborate with development teams to understand business requirements and translate them into test scenarios.
·           Develop, execute and maintain functional, integration, regression and performance test cases.
·           Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, or Azure DevOps
·           Experience with performance testing tools like JMeter.
·           Familiarity with BDD tools like Cucumber or SpecFlow.
·           Preferrable ISTQB or equivalent certification
·           Technical, creative, and efficient extraction of related data and analysis techniques to ensure quality for prescribed business uses. Knowledge of different database systems and data relationships are critical in this role. Manages and performs all aspects of data analysis and validation, and application functional testing activities for a given effort.
·           Manual and automated test case creation / execution for testing projects related to healthcare. The position requires deep technical skills, the ability to grasp business concepts quickly and experience working in an agile environment.
·           Oversees and performs all aspects of application testing activities for Web / Mobile iOS / Android functional and automated testing of both native, hybrid and web applications
·           Recognized as a subject matter expert (SME) in testing & mobile. Coaches associate test analysts and test analysts.
·           Analyzes functional requirements for initiatives that are expected to return significant business value, may require a change to enterprise business solution(s).
·           Leads and or validates the development and accuracy of test cases, test data, traceability matrix, and metrics to ensure all testing requirements are accurate. Communicates / presents results to IT and key stakeholders. Tracks and verifies any required corrections and ensures completion.
·           Modifies test cases, assists the development team in recreation of defects, validates defect fixes based on documented defects
·           Diagnoses results and analyzes large output datasets for accuracy and integrity across multiple systems; analyze cross-functional impact of changes in relationship to software updates, bug fixes, new releases of software internally or externally developed. Communicates results to IT and key stakeholders. Tracks and verifies any required corrections and ensures completion.
·           Helps to ensure project testing activities are completed on–time and without delivery of critical defects to the field; ensures team members are properly prepared and enabled to complete their assigned duties
·           Ability to work with development to build and execute automated tests
·           Participates in development planning meetings with the product analyst and development team and communicates with business and IT on the status of testing activities and other assigned activities in meeting project delivery deadlines
·           Participate in discussions with stakeholders pertaining to project estimates, schedules and critical issues that would prevent go / no–go
·           Continually incorporates process efficiencies without sacrificing quality. Ability to build both manual and automated regression suites and track cost savings for automation.
·           Helps define and implement operational and process improvements for testing activities; enables increase in quality of software delivered for testing through increased visibility of defects and delays
·           Builds and maintains an automation framework for use of DB, API, UI, mobile and performance testing

R EPORTING STRUCTURE
Does this position formally supervise employees?  (Y / N)
No

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification:
Bachelor’s of technology in any specialization
Years of  E xperience :
·           3+ years comparable work experience

Skills and Capabilities
Details
People Management Skills
·           Ability to lead others to accomplish organizational goals and objectives; provide meaningful                   coaching and mentoring to increase the capabilities of individuals and teams and drive employee engagement
·           Ability to make timely, informed decisions that are in the best interest of our patients, employees, providers, community and HCA Healthcare India
·           Ability to deliver information in a clear, concise, and compelling manner to effectively engage others and achieve desired results
·           Ability to develop and strengthen collaborative relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to advance the care of our patients and the growth of HCA Healthcare India
Technical Skills
·           Experience with Selenium, Postman/Newman
·           Experience using JMeter
·           Experience with Appium (Mobile iOS Testing)
·           Experience testing EMR Systems (Meditech, Cerner, Epic, Expanse, etc.)
·           Experience writing basic automated scripts using any tool / language
·           Experience in training other testers
·           Use and teach other SDETs about various QA tools and toolsets, such as MS Unit, TestNG, Selenium WebDriver, NUnit, Selenium Grid, Jenkins, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps etc
·           Demonstrate logic and analytical ability
·           Experience testing using Cloud technologies
·           Experience using Jira, ALM, DevOps
·           On–premise and public cloud networking knowledge
·           Mobile testing of enterprise native applications including interface, compatibility, usability testing
·           Experience with scripting protocols
·           Experience with test automation in CI / CD pipelines
·           Security testing
·           Technical writing and documentation
·           Knowledge of IT infrastructure
·           Knowledge and full understanding of the  s oftware  d evelopment  l ifecycle
·           Understanding and knowledge of industry standard performance testing processes
·           Experience in API testing
Other Skills
·           Ability to demonstrate an uncompromising commitment to delivering exceptional care to create an unmatched value proposition
·           Fluent in English for working in a multi–culture environment
·           Ability to build trust and act with authenticity to cultivate a culture of integrity, inclusion, and mutual respect
·           Ability to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation, remove barriers and resistance, and enable desired behaviors
·           Willingness to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture

description_text:
JOB INFORMATION
Job  Title  Name:
Senior - DevOps Engineer
 
JOB PURPOSE
 
The Senior  Dev Ops Engineer  will play a crucial role in the development, deployment, and maintenance of the organization's infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration between software development and IT operations. The primary objective  of this individual  will be to streamline the software delivery process, enhance system reliability, and optimize automation for efficient deployment and scaling.
 

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
·         Design, implement, and manage scalable infrastructure solutions leveraging cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) to support application development, deployment, and operations.
·         Develop and maintain automated CI / CD pipelines to ensure swift and reliable software releases, from code commits to production deployment, employing tools with stakeholders (e.g., business stakeholders, product owners, project managers, and end users)
·         Utilize configuration management tools to automate and standardize the configuration of servers, applications, and environments
·         Establish monitoring systems to proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, ensuring system reliability and stability
·         Implement and maintain security best practices, conduct regular audits, ensure compliance with industry standards, and work on tools like Terraform
·         Collaborate closely with development, operations, and QA teams to foster a culture of DevOps, promoting collaboration, communication, and knowledge sharing
·         Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in the development, test, and production environments, ensuring minimal downtime and smooth operations
·         Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, guidelines, and best practices for infrastructure setup, deployment processes, and troubleshooting steps
·         Stay updated with the latest DevOps trends, tools, and technologies, evaluating their applicability and potential benefits for the organization
 
 
R EPORTING STRUCTURE
Does this position formally supervise employees?  (Y / N)
No

 
JOB SPECIFICATIONS
Qualification:
B.Tech or Bachelor’s degree in  i nformation  t echnology,  c omputer  s cience, or related fields
Years of Experience:
6+ years of experience in D ev O ps, deployment, and operations

 

Skills and Capabilities
Details
People Management
·         Work closely with management, architects, and other teams to develop and implement the projects
·         Actively participate in technical group discussions and adopt any innovative technologies to improve the development and operations
 
Technical Skills
·         Strong Azure DevOPs experience
·         Experience with various deployment strategies.
·         Experience with version control (Git) and open–source practices
·         Experience with GitHub, including GitHub actions
·         Experience with automation of CI / CD pipelines
·         Experience with infrastructure pipelines using Terraform
·         Experience in cloud native, deploying within cloud environments, serverless development and / or container–based solutions
·         Strong understanding of object–oriented programing, familiarity with functional programing is a plus
·         Strong understanding of best practices in the design of REST–based APIs
·         Strong ability to understand context for code, the codebase, and its relation to business           objectives
Other Skills
·         C omfortable in moving to different technical ecosystems from project to project that will require discovery and adaptation to systems, teams, and business stakeholders
·         Ability to multitask and balance competing priorities
·         Ability to utilize best practice techniques and to impose order in a fast-changing environment
·         Must have strong problem–solving skills
·         Interested in learning newer technologies and sharing knowledge with teammates
·         Comfortable and proficient in a dynamic, agile team environment
·         Able to work with a team and independently
·         Great organizational and communication skills
·         Willingness to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture

title: Senior - Fullstack Developer
description_text:
JOB INFORMATION

Job Title Name:

Senior - Fullstack Developer

JOB
PURPOSE

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, your
primary role is to develop, maintain, and optimize server-side applications using
.Net and VueJS . You will ensure these applications meet high-performance,
scalability, and reliability standards. The role involves working with modern
technologies, managing data flow, and collaborating with cross-functional
teams to deliver innovative solutions. A strong background in both front-end
and back-end development, coupled with experience in cloud-based
technologies, is essential. Design, create and
maintain applications using the .NET backend platform and environment.
Understand requirements, transform them into functional applications in line
with business objectives, maintain and upgrade existing applications and fix
issues.

MAJOR
RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Collaboration :

·       
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product
managers, designers, engineers, and third-party partners, to ensure the
backend development aligns with overall project goals.

·       
Participate in discussions and planning sessions to understand
project requirements and contribute to the design and architecture of
server-side applications.

·       
Translate design mockups from UI/UX designers into responsive,
user-friendly web applications.

Development :

·       
Design, develop, and maintain .NET Core applications and
services.

·       
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and applications using Vue
JS.

·       
Implement data exchange formats like JSON and XML.

·       
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

·       
Use HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and .NET for
backend development.

·       
Manage code repositories with Git and GitHub.

·       
Ensure code quality through reviews and adherence to
guidelines.

Agile Practices :

·       
Participate in Agile development processes, including Scrum
practices, to ensure efficient and iterative development.

·       
Engage in regular code reviews, automated unit testing,
end-to-end testing, continuous integration, and deployment to maintain
high-quality code and rapid delivery.

Optimization :

·       
Identify and resolve technical issues, bugs, and performance
bottlenecks to enhance overall system performance.

·       
Debug and optimize backend code to ensure maximum efficiency
and reliability.

Database Management :

·       
Design and maintain databases, ensuring optimal performance,
reliability, and data integrity for backend systems.

·       
Write efficient and optimized database queries for data
retrieval and manipulation, contributing to the overall performance of the
applications.

·        Design and maintain databases using PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and NoSQL.

·       
Work with structured and
unstructured datasets for data flow and analytics.

Cloud Computing & Infrastructure:

·        Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms such as GCP and
Azure.

·        Leverage cloud-native services for development, data integration,
and continuous deployment.

·        Optimize cloud resources for performance, scalability, and
cost-effectiveness.

DevOps & CI/CD:

·       
Leverage and collaborate on CI/CD
pipelines for seamless code deployment.

·        Enhance system observability through logging, monitoring, and
alerting strategies.

Testing and Documentation :

·       
Cover new implementations with unit tests and documentation to
ensure reliability and maintainability.

·       
Participate in code reviews, automated unit testing, end-to-end
testing, continuous integration, and deployment to maintain high-quality
code and rapid delivery.

Technical Support :

·       
Offer technical support for web, mobile, and desktop applications,
addressing user issues and providing solutions.

·       
Integrate data storage systems and maintain code quality to ensure
data integrity and application performance.

·       
Identify bottlenecks and address issues to ensure the best
performance of applications.

R EPORTING STRUCTURE

Does this position formally supervise employees? (Y / N)

No

JOB
SPECIFICATIONS

Qualification

Bachelor’s
degree in information technology, computer science or related fields

Y ears of E xperience

5-8 Years of relevant work
experience including :

·       
3+ year(s) of engineering, delivering
and supporting production software products (required)

·        5+ year(s) experience with .Net,
ASP.Net, C#, VueJS . (required)

Skills
and Capabilities

Details

People Management Skills

·        Exceptional
stakeholder service
skills in a team–oriented, collaborative environment

·        Exceptional
interpersonal skills to interface with all levels of the organization

·       
Strong
verbal and written communication with the ability to work with staff and
business           required

Technical
Skills

·        Proficiency in modern
JavaScript frameworks ( VueJS ) and d eep knowledge of .NET
technologies , ASP.net,
MVC RAZOR (required).

·        Knowledge of
UX framework like Figma and Modular
UI Components (desired)

·        Knowledge of other frontend
technologies like ReactJS (Preferred)

·        Experience with GCP, Azure, and
their services like Kubernetes, Pub/Sub, Message Bus (Preferable)

·        Experience with tools like
Terraform, ARM templates, and Docker.

·       
Expertise
in PostgreSQL, SQL Server, BigTable, and non-relational databases. (Required)

·       
Experience
with Event Driven and Orchestration Architectures.

·       
Experience
with CI/CD pipelines using Git Workflows, Jenkins, and similar tools.

Other
Skills

·        Strong focus on delivering
stakeholders value required

·        Excellent troubleshooting,
analysis, and problem–solving abilities required

·        Willingness to learn our
business domain required

·        Experience with continuous
integration and continuous deployment preferred

·        Strong analytical and problem–solving
skills

·        Ability to troubleshoot and
debug complex issues

·        Proactive attitude toward
learning new technologies and industry best practices

·        Ability to work collaboratively
in a team environment

·        Willingness to contribute to a
positive and inclusive team culture

PURPOSE

updates, ensuring the application remains functional and up-to-date.

Introduce various features into the product, from design solutions

Re-write and make changes to existing code structures to increase

methodologies for security, quality, and development approaches.

to best coding practices.

Test, monitor, and make better solutions through incremental

Cover new implementations with unit tests and documentation to

Participate in code reviews, automated unit testing, end-to-end

5+ year’s
experience in Vue.js, .Net frontend technologies for web application

Working
knowledge of front–end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Ajax, and

compoments

Job Title Name:

 

Senior – Product Analyst

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

JOB PURPOSE:

The HCA Senior Product
Analyst leads activities ensuring the creation, adoption, and improvement of
assigned processes within a ServiceNow application. This position owns the
definition of product goals, aligning those goals to both HCA’s strategy and
industry best practices, and promoting them to business, IT leaders, and
other stakeholders.  The Senior Product Analyst will work closely with
internal and external stakeholders to design, implement and manage the
assigned process workflows within the organization. Operational
responsibilities include, end-to-end ownership of one or more processes
within their managed ServiceNow application(s), creating requirements for
implementation of processes, and serving as a subject matter expert within
the ideation phase to determine the execution path.

 

The Product Analyst will interact and collaborate with
users from supported hospitals, representatives from the HCA division service
desks and shared service centers, vendor representatives and other HCA
corporate departments to ensure expected value is realized.
